title: FRMT: A Benchmark for Few-Shot Region-Aware Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance gap in machine translation models between web-majority (e.g., Brazilian Portuguese, Mainland Mandarin) and web-minority (e.g., European Portuguese, Taiwan Mandarin) regional language varieties using a targeted few-shot benchmark dataset (FRMT) measured with human expert ratings (MQM) and automated metrics (BLEU, BLEURT, and a custom Lexical accuracy metric).
